# Eld Docs

> Official documentation for Eld — a Proof-of-Stake blockchain for time-bounded, content-addressed (ephemeral) data storage.

## Site

- Home: https://docs.eld.network
- Marketing: https://www.eld.network
- Explorer: https://explorer.eld.network
- GitHub: https://github.com/eldnetwork

## Key pages

- [Quickstart](https://docs.eld.network/quickstart): create a wallet, faucet, first transfer
- [Litepaper](https://docs.eld.network/litepaper): protocol narrative (pinboard, capacity, TTL)
- [Litepaper (Markdown)](https://docs.eld.network/litepaper.md): raw protocol narrative for citation
- [FAQ](https://docs.eld.network/faq): ephemeral storage, CADO, testnet
- [Eld CLI](https://docs.eld.network/eld-cli): `eld-cli` command reference
- [Accounts](https://docs.eld.network/accounts-overview): Ed25519 addresses and wallets
- [Capacity providers](https://docs.eld.network/capacity-provider): storage slots and challenges
- [Custom namespaces](https://docs.eld.network/namespaces): `@slug` registration and uploads

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://docs.eld.network/sitemap.xml)
